name: Four Seasons Hotel George V, Paris
description:
Four Seasons Hotel George V is a Four Seasons property near the Champs-Elysees in Paris, holding the largest collection of apartment suites of any Parisian palace hotel, with several suites overlooking the Eiffel Tower.
Facilities include parking and room service.
The property holds a combined five Michelin stars across three restaurants, including Le George led by chef Simone Zanoni, who offers a Versailles kitchen-garden visit and cooking class, with the wine cellar headed by a former Best Sommelier in Europe.
